hero.eyebrow: Weekend MVP Build-Along · Live on Zoom
hero.title: Build it Saturday.
hero.body: A {hours}-hour live build-along on {sessionStart}. You build your MVP while I build mine, and you can ask questions as you go.

included.title: What's
items: {hours} hours live on Zoom with John
The Ship Sheet: your 48-hour plan, as a doc you can copy
The copy-paste prompts used in the session
A prep email before the session, so you arrive ready to build

agenda.title: Three moves, then

opening.title: Open
opening.body: What we're doing today. Everyone opens the Ship Sheet.

sharpest.title: Move 1: Your sharpest idea
sharpest.body: Run your idea through the weekend test. Post your one-liner in the chat and I'll react to as many as time allows.

weekendCut.title: Move 2: The weekend cut
weekendCut.body: Cut it to three screens and one action. We kill features out loud.

build.title: Move 3: Build and deploy
build.body: I build an example live. You build yours at the same time and paste your link in the chat when it's up.

safety.title: Ship it safely
safety.body: Three checks before you share the link: nothing private shows in view-source, your keys aren't in the repo, and the login actually protects the data.

firstUsers.title: First users
firstUsers.body: Pick one channel, write the first post, and decide which 10 people you'll show it to on Sunday.

questions.title: Q&A
questions.body: Your questions, and links in the chat.

agenda.closing: There's a visible timer for each block, and I'll have a pre-built fallback ready in case something breaks on my side.

forYou.title: This is for you if
items: You're a designer who wants to ship something real with AI, and keep your taste in it.
You're a non-technical founder with a day job and no co-founder.
You've watched enough tutorials and want to actually build one.
You'd rather have someone to ask when it breaks.

notForYou.title: It's not for you if
items: You want to sit back and watch. You'll build during the session, so this isn't a watch-only webinar. (The free webinar on {freeDay} is the watch-only one.)

deal.fallback: You leave with your MVP's first version built, and the steps to put it live the same day.
deal.dryRun: You leave with a live URL.

laptop.title: A laptop
laptop.body: Not a phone or tablet. You'll be building.

idea.title: One idea
idea.body: Or none, and we'll pick one from the library in the first half hour.

tools.title: A free tool account
tools.configured: On {tools}, set up before we start. The prep email shows you how.
tools.unconfigured: Set up before we start. The prep email shows you how.

deal.closing: What you don't need: code, a co-founder or a design file.

host.eyebrow: Why a designer is running this
host.body: Every idea on the site is researched, sized for a weekend and paired with prompts. In this session we use that method on your idea.

personalNote.standard: The session is {sessionStartWithAt}, and the replay is yours to keep if you can't make it live.

value.question: Do I need to code?
value.answer: No. We build with AI tools and copy-paste prompts. If you can follow steps and paste text, you can follow along. Knowing some code helps, but you don't need it.

value.question: Which tools will we use, and what will they cost me?
value.answer: We'll use {tools}. Free accounts are enough for the session. The prep email tells you exactly what to set up and how.

value.question: What if my idea isn't ready, or I don't have one?
value.answer: That's fine. In Move 1 we run ideas through the weekend test. If yours doesn't fit, or you don't have one, you'll pick one from the library and build that.

value.question: I can't make it live. Should I still buy?
value.answer: You can. Your ticket includes the replay, with no expiry, plus the Ship Sheet and prompts. You'll miss asking questions live, so if that's what you want, come live.

value.question: How many seats are there?
value.answer: {seatsTotal}. When they're gone, tickets close and the next build-along is {nextBuildAlongLabel}.

value.question: What time is it for me?
Where does it happen?
value.answer: On Zoom. The join link comes by email after you buy, and again in the reminders before the session.

value.question: Is this the same as the free webinar?
value.answer: No. The free webinar on {freeDay} is an hour of watching: the method and one idea taken to a first screen. This is {buildAlongDuration} of building your own, with me building alongside you. If you came to the free one, this is the next step. If you didn't, the build-along still starts from the beginning.

value.question: What if the session is cancelled?
What currency is the price in?
value.answer: US dollars: {priceLine}. Price shown in USD. Any tax is shown at checkout.

ticket.title: One ticket.
ticket.earlyBirdNote: The {earlyPrice} price ends at {earlyCutoff} and I don't extend it.
